title: A review of the use of tumour DNA methylation for breast cancer subtyping and prediction of outcomes.
authors: Zarean, Elaheh; Li, Shuai; Southey, Melissa C; Dugue, Pierre-Antoine
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦乳腺癌DNA甲基化分型与预后预测，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: DNA methylation in breast tumours has been extensively studied and has provided valuable insights into the clinical heterogeneity of breast cancer. In this review, we summarise the current literature that has used DNA methylation markers to subtype breast cancer and predict progression and survival. Widespread methylation differences have been observed across breast cancer subtypes at both the candidate genes and in genome-wide analyses, most notably between oestrogen receptor (ER) positive and ER-negative subtypes and for triple-negative tumours. Studies that attempted to create breast cancer subtypes using methylation data showed limited agreement in their capacity to group breast tumours, possibly due to methodological differences. Although many studies have reported associations of tumour DNA methylation with breast cancer outcomes and used machine learning methods to derive prediction models for survival, the extent to which these would replicate in independent datasets is currently unclear. We conclude that despite the potential of genome-wide methylation markers to unravel the heterogeneity of breast cancer, they currently appear to have limited clinical utility. Larger studies and replication of findings across studies are required to address the limitations of the existing literature.
abstract_zh: 乳腺肿瘤中的DNA甲基化已被广泛研究，并为乳腺癌的临床异质性提供了宝贵见解。在本综述中，我们总结了当前利用DNA甲基化标记对乳腺癌进行亚型分类及预测进展和生存的文献。在候选基因和全基因组分析中，乳腺癌亚型间观察到广泛的甲基化差异，尤其是在雌激素受体（ER）阳性与ER阴性亚型之间，以及三阴性肿瘤中。尝试使用甲基化数据创建乳腺癌亚型的研究在分组乳腺肿瘤的能力上显示出有限的一致性，这可能归因于方法学差异。尽管许多研究报告了肿瘤DNA甲基化与乳腺癌结局的关联，并利用机器学习方法推导生存预测模型，但这些模型在独立数据集中复现的程度目前尚不清楚。我们得出结论，尽管全基因组甲基化标记在揭示乳腺癌异质性方面具有潜力，但目前其临床实用性似乎有限。需要更大规模的研究和跨研究结果的复现，以解决现有文献的局限性。
